# Is this tender ready for your attention?

> Paste a public tender and get a fast bid-readiness checklist for deadlines, bonds, insurance, certifications, questions, and submission instructions. Runs privately in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tender-bid-readiness/)

- [This checker vs. GovWin IQ](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/tender-bid-readiness/vs-govwin.html)
